rows.note: This is the everyday all-purpose choice when a person or thing disappears from view or is no longer seen.

example.english: The umbrella we just saw seems to vanish.
example.traditional: 頭先仲見到嗰把遮，而家唔見咗。
example.jyutping: tau4 sin1 zung6 gin3 dou2 go2 baa2 ze1 ji4 gaa1 m4 gin3 zo2

rows.note: Use this in mathematics when a quantity or function has a value of zero.

example.english: The expression will vanish when the unknown is one.
example.traditional: 個未知數等於一嗰陣，條式就等於零。
example.jyutping: go3 mei6 zi1 sou3 dang2 jyu1 jat1 go2 zan6 tiu4 sik1 zau6 dang2 jyu1 ling4

rows.note: Use this for the forced-kidnapping reading, when someone is made to disappear by being abducted.

example.english: The businessman was kidnapped and made to vanish for a whole week.
example.traditional: 嗰個商人畀人綁架咗，成個星期都冇消息。
example.jyutping: go2 go3 soeng1 jan4 bei2 jan4 bong2 gaa3 zo2 seng4 go3 sing1 kei4 dou1 mou5 siu1 sik1
